bhikkhuto.g: dve dhammakkhandhasahassāni bhikkhuto uggaṇhiṁ, dhammasenāpati-ādīnaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ santikā adhigaṇhiṁ.
dhammasenāpati-ādīnaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ santikā tehi yeva desitāni dve sahassāni gaṇhiṁ.
dve dhammakkhandhasahassāni bhikkhuto gaṇhiṁ, Dhammasenāpati-ādīnaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ santikā adhigacchiṁ.

bhikkhuta.g: dve dhammakkhandhasahassāni bhikkhuto uggaṇhiṁ, dhammasenāpati-ādīnaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ santikā adhigaṇhiṁ.

dve dhammakkhandhasahassāni bhikkhuto gaṇhiṁ, Dhammasenāpati-ādīnaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ santikā adhigacchiṁ.

bhikkhūti.g: Bhagavato imaṁ pabbājento1 kuhiṁ satthakaṁ labhissāmi, kuhiṁ pattacīvaranti pariyesanakiccaṁ natthi, kammaṁ pana olokesi.
so ve bhinnakilesattā bhikkhu nāma vuccati.
yathā purimavāre “bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyyā”ti āgataṁ, evaṁ idha “bhāvite kho bhikkhave ānāpānassatisamādhimhī”ti āgatavāre bhikkhuggahaṇamakataṁ, tasmā “so”ti na vuttaṁ.

bhikkhūti.l: Sekkho bhikkhūti satta sekkhā kathitā, bhinnattā pāpakānaṁ -pa- bhikkhūti khīṇāsavova kathito
bhikkhūti.g: idaṁ dvayaṁ “sekkhoti puthujjanakalyāṇakena saddhiṁ satta ariyā, bhinnattāti iminā pana cattāro phalaṭṭhā”ti iminā dvayena na sameti, tadidaṁ nippariyāyadassanaṁ vuttanti veditabbaṁ.
